heroSection.badge: Decision Support System • Transparent and Measurable

description.first: Distromatch is a Decision Support System (DSS)-based platform that helps users find the most suitable Linux distro through a transparent and easy-to-understand calculation process.
description.second: The system combines TOPSIS, Bayesian shrinkage, and penalty-based ranking to ensure recommendations remain objective, stable, and relevant to user preferences.

surveyNeeds.title: Needs Survey
surveyNeeds.description: Transforms user answers into scores for each need dimension.

decisionAnalysis.title: Decision Analysis
decisionAnalysis.description: Processes data using weighting, TOPSIS, and Bayesian methods.

transparentRanking.title: Transparent Ranking
transparentRanking.description: Displays clear utility scores and distro rankings.

surveyWeight.title: Survey & Weighting
surveyWeight.description: Scores for each dimension are calculated and weighted based on preferences.

normalizationTopsis.title: Normalization & TOPSIS
normalizationTopsis.description: Normalized matrix, ideal solutions, and closeness coefficient.

bayesianShrinkage.title: Bayesian Shrinkage
bayesianShrinkage.description: Stabilizes scores when review data is limited.

symmetricPenalty.title: Symmetric Penalty
symmetricPenalty.description: Reduces scores when distro levels are too far from user preferences.

utilityRanking.title: Utility & Ranking
utilityRanking.description: Final scores (0–1) are ranked with review-based tie-breakers.

description.first: Many users, especially beginners, struggle to choose a Linux distro because of the overwhelming number of options and scattered information.
description.second: Distromatch helps simplify this process with a transparent data-driven system, allowing decisions to be made more clearly and confidently.
